description:
One dated, hashed record of what public FMCSA data shows about a
carrier, built for a broker's carrier-vetting file. Paid, flat price.

It gathers, in one response: the carrier's current profile (authority,
insurance flags, FMCSA safety rating and its date, out-of-service
orders, fleet and classifications, MCS-150 filing date, first authority
grant, revocation, suspension and reinstatement history), the SMS
inspection and violation summary with out-of-service rates, the
trailing-24-month crash summary, the last year's changes, and the
identity-linkage triage screen, the insurance continuity history (gaps and
cancellations, each with its data-through date) and the authority event
history (grants, reinstatements, revocations, suspensions). review_factors lists each factor a
documented review commonly considers and whether this record carries it.

It is a record, not a score. It never says a carrier is safe or unsafe,
"Unrated" is reported as exactly that, and it is not legal advice or a
statement that choosing a carrier was reasonable. This project's own
safety_tier_derived is deliberately left out.

Integrity: record_hash is the SHA-256 of the record's canonical JSON (see
hash_method) without record_hash and verify_url. Keep the record; later,
GET verify_url (free) confirms that we issued exactly that hash, when, and
for which carrier, so an edited copy is detectable. If the hash cannot be
registered the call returns registry_unavailable and is not billed. An
unknown USDOT number is a free not_found.
name: get_carrier_selection_record
